Dribble 2026
------------

Subtitle
College basketball dynasty. Call every play.

Description
Take a job. Build a roster. Call every possession.

Dribble 2026 is a college basketball dynasty sim with 365 facsimile Division I programs, a 30-game regular season, holiday events, league tournaments, and a 68-team National Tournament — plus The Invite and The Crown.

You are the head coach. Play the next game and call motion, post, press — or sim it. The play you call is the play they run.

• Career, Pick a school, or Eras (1960s–2020s)
• 365 original school names (city and campus facsimiles — no licensed marks)
• Recruiting board, scholarships, visits, and a 100-player national board
• Eval ranks, Efficiency board, and Writers poll — every team
• The Desk and Sunday Board brackets, bubble lists, Selection Day reveal
• Save up to eight files on this device

Schools, leagues, and ranking desks are original names inspired by the real sport. Not affiliated with any university, conference, or media company.

Category: Games / Sports
Age: 4+
Price: free (or set your price in App Store Connect / Play Console)

Keywords
basketball, coach, dynasty, college, sports, sim, recruiting, tournament, bracket
